questions.question: Identify the correct form of the sentence with inversion required by the adverbial phrase: 'Only after extensive research ______ the true significance of the discovery.'

Which option correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location in the following context? The conference was held in London, but it was in Manchester that the networking opportunities were the most valuable.
options: It was in Manchester that the networking opportunities were the most valuable.
Manchester was where the networking opportunities were the most valuable.
The most valuable networking opportunities were in Manchester.
Manchester was the place where the networking opportunities were the most valuable.
questions.answer: It was in Manchester that the networking opportunities were the most valuable.

questions.question: Select the correct formal register option for the subjunctive mood in this context: 'We require that all submissions ______ by the deadline.'
Which of the following demonstrates correct ellipsis in a complex sentence? 'If you want to succeed, you must work hard; ______ , you will fail.'

Choose the option that correctly employs a complex sentence structure with appropriate conjunction and clause arrangement: 'Despite the challenging circumstances, the team completed the project not only on time but also with a high level of quality.'
options: Despite the challenging circumstances, the team completed the project not only on time but also with a high level of quality.
The team completed the project not only on time but also with a high level of quality despite the challenging circumstances.
Completed the project not only on time but also with a high level of quality, despite the challenging circumstances, the team did.
Not only on time but also with a high level of quality, the team completed the project despite the challenging circumstances.
questions.answer: Despite the challenging circumstances, the team completed the project not only on time but also with a high level of quality.
